purpose: Choose a course deliberately despite a reason to avoid it.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
敢えて + action; 敢えて + negative
Today I am deliberately taking the long way home.
I chose not to ask the reason.
I deliberately voiced a dissenting opinion at the meeting.
formation: 敢えて + action; 敢えて + negative
restrictions: Highlights a conscious choice against expectations.
mistake: With a negative, it means deliberately refraining, not trying harder.
